run_infer_video: run inference on a video file to detect keypoints, boxes, and segments using Caffe2 model
get_resolution: get the width and height resolution of a video file using ffprobe
read_video: read a video file frame by frame as numpy arrays using ffmpeg image2pipe
process_video_inference: process a single video or all videos in a folder and save detection results as npz
initialize_model_inference: initialize a Caffe2 model from weights config and run frame-level detection on video frames
